description: Engineering Profiles: logical, model-independent role bindings. Routing selects an EXECUTION CLASS; the active profile decides WHICH model fulfills the mapped role. Changing a profile must not require any routing or controller code change.

profiles.description: Default Nexus behavior: DeepSeek V4 Flash engineers (HIGH normal / MAX deep) with an unlimited, read-only independent Codex review (budget enforcement off by default) and approval-gated Codex solve. Equivalent to the pre-Phase-2 production system.

GLM engineers (GLM-5.3-Flash primary / GLM-5.3-Flash MAX deep = the Flash model at max reasoning) with an unlimited, read-only independent Codex review (budget enforcement off by default) and approval-gated Codex solve. A stronger manual tier (e.g. GLM-5.3 MAX) stays available as an operator-selected binding; it is never an automatic escalation target.
